name: trowel
description: A lean spec-to-code build workflow. One Workflow script: preflight in code, a planner only when the spec is too big for one builder, builders that reuse what the project already has, each slice spec-checked as it lands, one code check that runs the project's real end-to-end suite, and at most two batched fix rounds. Three agents, a counted and capped number of agent calls, no MCP server.
